entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or an Apache-2.0 open-source SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% token reduction and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated brain for Hermes Agents generates synthesized prose answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It builds a self-wiring knowledge graph by extracting typed entity edges while maintaining verified data isolation for multi-user access.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is an official provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling, utilizing byte-level deduplication to secure a 100% prompt-cache discount.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows that allow agent memory to learn over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and offers flexible deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud services.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a reasoning-first memory library that extracts conclusions from conversation history to build stateful agents. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs, supporting managed, local, and Docker Compose deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a five-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local data storage and sub-millisecond performance. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code via a simple Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent vector search and structured facts. It features an auto-curated wiki and a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts like traces and playbooks to help agents with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate the effectiveness of context changes.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides a DAG-based context engine for Hermes Agent that ensures no messages are lost during processing. It uses a local SQLite store with full-text search metadata and provides tools for agents to search and expand compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores information as human-readable YAML engrams on the local disk for multi-agent systems. It utilizes a hybrid search mechanism combining BM25 and local embeddings to facilitate retrieval across tools like Claude Code and Codex.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and plugins, employing hybrid retrieval through BM25 and vector search to manage agent memory.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference by reordering blocks and deduplicating data to enhance prefix reuse. It offers native plugin support for Hermes Agent, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3× while saving up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It features a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled result. It includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for agent queries.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. Developed for the Hermes 2026 Hackathon, it functions as an MCP-native server compatible with major coding clients.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn establishes cross-project memory by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores information in inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for coding agents.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, rendering data into files like AGENTS.md. This local-first architecture supports MCP and aims to reduce prompt tokens by 94%.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 ranking for tool schemas. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent memory. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority entries and supports BM25 keyword search alongside named graph relationships.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer stores identity and project state in plain Markdown files for coding agents. It uses hash-checked proposals for session handoffs and provides dedicated adapters for Hermes, Claude Code, and Cursor.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that addresses persistent summary issues by supporting real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and generates a trace.jsonl audit log for every prefetch operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains. It allows agents to settle payments directly to wallets with 0% transaction fees via a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and MCP server configurations to facilitate capability routing. It provides tools for artifact search and graph neighbor traversal, using feedback to improve local routing hints.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It features a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox for searching and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports manual memory storage and offers configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon with built-in MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories using a local SourceVault server for vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands for search and sync, supporting grounded Q&A through LLM-callable tools.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This suite offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid BM25, vector, and graph search. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A database-free curation tool that uses a git-backed directory of Markdown files to manage agent memory. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale data and proposes evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology for autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design system for macOS and Windows that generates prototypes and documents using real CSS and components. It features a coding-agent CLI that supports Hermes Agent alongside DeepSeek Harness and Claude Code.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST CSF 2.0. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms for specialized security operations.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee functions as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients in Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It includes 11 diagram presets and features self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool provides a master router for mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. it includes a verification and dispute resolution layer to facilitate secure transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using five optional voice profiles. It is compatible with agentskills.io-compliant platforms, including Claude Code and Hermes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that natively integrates with Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and monitoring session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state within the project's documentation directory for persistent context.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 1,153 skills with native support for Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes ready-to-paste exports for other assistants and integrations for platforms like Slack, Telegram, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other platforms to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports tools like Cursor and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains and reports findings alongside an analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for Pydantic AI through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes for varying project complexity and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source file edits back to the original literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for long-running agents using a mechanism kernel that operates without a background service. It manages four distinct roles—Human, Supervisor, Lead, and Peer—and requires Herdr for hosting supervisor rooms.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts, supporting CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized services for CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project provides a collection of skills in the SKILL.md format specifically for the Portuguese-speaking community. It includes installation and configuration guides that adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX image and video generation. The project includes a router for managing multi-step video workflows via Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned instruction files compliant with agentskills.io. It links instructions to specific source lines and includes lifecycle tooling for creating and testing skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, accessible via a Python client or CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution for installations and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step task execution with autonomous tracking of progress and decisions. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project provides a local-first workflow language for AI that uses a single Rust binary and four verbs to execute tasks. It ensures operational safety by auditing cost ceilings, secret flows, and types before spending tokens, while generating hash-chained receipts for verifiable run history.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It features a guided setup script for credential validation and maintains secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill implements a five-layer retrieval system—including hard triggers, FTS5, and semantic embeddings—to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It optimizes token efficiency and features graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This community hub facilitates the browsing, search, and one-click installation of skills using the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution OS uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It allows an AI agent to handle system design via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while the user focuses on task completion.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review tool uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and integration analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for multi-story task decomposition and mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for managing persistent task states.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This multi-agent skill employs specialized sub-agents for hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages such as Python, Rust, and Go. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for all changes.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports the automatic registration of skill directories and uses SKILL.md files to facilitate progressive disclosure.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation based on real-world CVEs. It integrates 28 different frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, and NIST.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project provides production-tested skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode, featuring session management for memory between conversations. It enables parallel subagent orchestration for code reviews and includes tools for worktree recovery and state drift detection.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It optimizes files to remain under 8 MB and embeds the rendered results directly into the documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable Agent Skills from plain language while preventing skill rot. It utilizes a validator to detect drift against runtime-specific profiles and monitors official frontmatter specs weekly.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic feedback loop analyzes session history to identify and propose improvements for AI agent skill coverage. It gates updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators using only the Python standard library.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills directly from a terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: Designed for Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL, these skills manage deterministic path routing for file operations. They also facilitate the selection and verification of existing, project-compatible Python interpreters.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first observability dashboard provides real-time monitoring of token costs, health, sessions, and errors with zero outbound telemetry. It features 11 monitoring tabs and an optional script for Telegram and Feishu incident alerts.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides functional quality certification for agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties, buying context, and creating bounty boards.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports with core conclusions and uses semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Compatible with the agentskills.io standard, this suite includes tools for video-to-text, OCR, and AI writing refinement. Support for macOS and Linux varies depending on specific skill requirements.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project enables Hermes Agent to access structured web data across 31 platforms by exposing 191 tools through a hosted MCP server. It includes five production-grade workflow skills and supports integration with environments such as Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for Hermes across various interfaces, including CLI tools, desktop applications, and agentic IDEs. It serves as a specialized distribution point for users who require consistent, versioned access to the agent's ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers scripts and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile-specific agent workflows.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line automated installer for deploying Hermes Agent within Android Termux environments. The setup supports over 70 tools and persistent memory, allowing the agent to function using either external providers or local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on cloud-native state safety and single-writer storage enforcement. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including configurable gateway modes with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS platforms using Termux and iSH. It extends agent functionality with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging, alongside support for scheduled cron jobs on mobile hardware.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-level enforcement. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing users to configure specific security policies for web search and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora acts as a self-hosted control plane for operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides operational oversight through per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps accessible via REST, CLI, or MCP.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible, declarative deployment of Hermes with integrated secret management via sops-nix. It features a hybrid skill management system that allows for both Nix-managed and CLI-installed agent capabilities.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It supports hierarchical inter-agent delegation and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This deployment option configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution, specifically supporting recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a researcher team to perform bullish and bearish debates, with final approvals handled by dedicated risk management and portfolio manager agents.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It supports local or Docker-based deployment and provides multiple interfaces including a Web UI, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages persistent coding agent sessions, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux for background execution. It facilitates multi-repo workspace management through Git worktrees and provides sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain using the Claude-style MCP protocol. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs during orchestrated workflows.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It implements a task bus pattern for delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features MCP tool integration and provides visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task statuses and review queues for Hermes agents. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure roles using a strict pipeline architecture. A Master Orchestrator manages all routing and coordination between these specialized entities.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents to manage the automated task lifecycle. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for tool handling and features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates two competing AI companies, each comprising nine autonomous agents, to compete for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080 and 5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling through parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server. It reduces token usage and tool calls by auto-syncing a pre-indexed representation of the codebase on every file change.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI-based utility that tracks token consumption across multiple coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a TUI and a 3D contribution graph dashboard, allowing users to submit data for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables inspection of API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, supporting any provider that uses markdown or general prompting.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLI tools directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical usage breakdowns categorized by session, project, and model.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This community-driven project allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes and ASCII art. It provides visual modifications such as custom banner colors and spinners, including aesthetics like retro DOS and cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable handles. It enables Hermes and other agents to conduct commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for various frameworks and includes a plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall. It also offers chat bot integrations for platforms such as Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings for Hermes Agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and research, supported by an automated cross-platform installation process.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents through local configurations and skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services at zero cost using free models. It offers three scalable deployment tiers, from minimum viable to production, and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter for AI agent configurations and system prompts that performs local, deterministic checks without API calls. It flags vague tool descriptions and missing termination conditions, supporting SARIF output for integration with GitHub Code Scanning.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills, into the Hermes Agent ecosystem. It maps existing configurations and credentials into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes config-aware baselines by watching local files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake word detection. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes-startup is a local-first skill designed to help users generate revenue online using dynamic slash commands and a deterministic local runtime. The tool prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes integrates with MemOS to provide semantic search and multi-dimensional memory storage. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and features a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with the Tauri 2 framework that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides centralized configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local open-source cowork application integrates dozens of external agents, including Hermes Agent, into a single interface. It features 21 built-in professional assistants and enables remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface built using Python and vanilla JavaScript that allows users to access Hermes Agent from a browser or phone. The interface includes a circular context ring to monitor token usage and supports secure access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to assist with the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent and its providers. It offers a graphical user interface for managing chats, sessions, and tools.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard providing multi-platform AI chat, session management, and usage analytics for Hermes Agent. It features a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and supports unified configuration for 10 messaging platforms, including Telegram and Discord.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It utilizes Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, alongside a full workspace file browser with Monaco.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes Agent and other tools into a desktop or self-hosted application. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and provides native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects directly to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, complemented by an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that also supports macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local execution and features a UI for MCP tools, memory management, and LaTeX/Mermaid rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium browsers that connects active browser context to a Hermes Agent runtime. It includes Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting in 31 writing environments and features live browser control with explicit approval gates.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI iPhone app for iOS 18+ that drives a self-hosted Hermes agent by pairing with a hermes-webui server. The app supports real-time chat, task management, and server file system browsing without subscriptions or third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace featuring one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, as well as a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based consciousness monitor features an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It enables users to track agent growth and scheduled cron jobs while providing a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a centralized control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and ZOO Swarm agent health. It features a browser-based terminal, real-time chat with tool call visualization, and a kanban pipeline for tracking agent tasks.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Operating locally on macOS 14+, this native session browser tracks live quota burn across 15 agent sources by model, tokens, or cost. It offers searchable transcripts and image browsing with a strict focus on privacy, requiring no telemetry or data uploads.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP to enable vocal interaction with cloud-hosted agents.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This OpenTUI-based dashboard provides a terminal interface for chatting with agents and managing their sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and tools for configuring agent profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA serves as a Telegram Mini App dashboard capable of spawning five concurrent background agent instances. It supports terminal chat with file attachments and uses HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 for secure Telegram authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to run Hermes Agent with local or cloud models. It features a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers alongside integrated support for TTS and ComfyUI workflows.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes an integrated file browser and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity, costs, and conversation histories. It offers read-only inspection of environment variables and configuration settings to ensure oversight of the agent's state.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace features real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure agent interactions. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with on-the-fly model switching.
